_note: Delivery prices for Malaysian citizens. Every price was read on the hospital's or ministry's own page on the 'checked' date. Private: only hospitals that publish a price. scripts/check_centres.py re-checks price_from_rm every 3 months.

university.name: Hospital Al-Sultan Abdullah (UiTM), Puncak Alam
university.standard_note_en: Normal delivery, 2 days 1 night, not first class. Includes bed, food, treatment, standard medicine and baby's injections. Epidural, vacuum and forceps cost extra.
university.standard_note_ms: Bersalin normal, 2 hari 1 malam, bukan kelas pertama. Termasuk katil, makanan, rawatan, ubat standard dan suntikan bayi. Epidural, vakum dan forsep dikenakan caj tambahan.
university.exec_note_en: HASA Executive (private wing): single room, specialist's fees included. Normal 2 days 1 night; elective caesarean 4 days 3 nights. Malaysians only, at least 2 visits with an Executive consultant, full deposit at 36 weeks.
university.exec_note_ms: HASA Executive (sayap swasta): bilik seorang, termasuk yuran pakar. Normal 2 hari 1 malam; caesarean terancang 4 hari 3 malam. Warganegara sahaja, sekurang-kurangnya 2 lawatan dengan pakar Executive, deposit penuh pada minggu ke-36.
